overview: PrakritiAI is an AI-powered Ayurvedic wellness platform that classifies your body type (Vata, Pitta, or Kapha) using a 12-question lifestyle questionnaire and simulated facial analysis, then delivers personalized diet, lifestyle, and herbal recommendations based on ancient Ayurvedic principles.
features: 12-question interactive Prakruti questionnaire with rule-based AI classification
Dosha breakdown visualization with animated bars (Vata/Pitta/Kapha percentages)
Personalized Ayurvedic recommendations: diet, lifestyle, herbs, and remedies
Image upload with simulated facial condition analysis (face shape, dark circles, puffiness)
Backend persistence for storing analysis results with timestamps
Full landing page: hero, about, features, how-it-works, demo, tech stack, footer
Dark purple/teal animated UI with scroll-triggered animations
